Hi Aisha — great to hear from you and thanks for sending those docs. Short answers up front, then a couple of action items:

- PO issuance: Redwood typically issues a provisional PO number for pilot activity once the onboarding form and W9 are uploaded and we've completed KYC checks. The final PO (with spend bands) is issued after commercial countersignature.
- Provisional token: yes — we can create a provisional PO token to allow provisioning. That token will have a default pilot spend cap of $15,000 unless finance requests otherwise.
- Line items: for pilots we usually map line items to a single pilot spend band. For expanded engagements we can split by SKU or category on the final PO.

Action items:
1) Marissa will confirm whether we can increase the pilot cap to $25k for BlueSea (they requested ability to run a 2-week load test).
2) Karthik will generate the provisional PO token and share the token/id back to Aisha.
3) Aisha, please confirm the single invoice routing and preferred billing contact.
